parameters.name: ResultTypeFilter
parameters.description: Indicates the transfer results that MUST be included when the USP Agent notifies a USP Controller of file transfers. Transfer results omitted from this list MUST NOT be included when the USP Agent notifies a USP Controller.

object.description: The policy defined in this object determines the conditions under which the USP Agent notifies a USP Controller, that has an appropriate Subscription, of the completion of file transfers.
